subject.title: Feature: Support Telegram media groups (albums) in message tool

question: Should OpenClaw adopt native outbound Telegram album sending now, using the linked fork PR as the starting point, or keep current sequential multi-media fan-out until maintainers define a narrower album contract?
rationale: This is a new visible Telegram channel capability with an open implementation candidate and several closed prior attempts, so automation should not supersede contributor work or choose album semantics without owner direction.

options.title: Review or port the linked PR
options.body: Use the open fork PR as the starting point, update it for current Telegram plugin boundaries, and require focused tests plus live Telegram proof before merge.

options.title: Define the album contract first
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers specify which surfaces, media kinds, captions, and fallback behavior should use native albums.

options.title: Defer native albums
options.body: Document current sequential mediaUrls fan-out as the supported behavior for now and explicitly defer Telegram album grouping.

recommendation.title: Review or port the linked PR
recommendation.body: Use the open fork PR as the starting point, update it for current Telegram plugin boundaries, and require focused tests plus live Telegram proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: obviyus has the strongest current-main ownership signal on the Telegram send/reply/outbound paths that album support would change.
